motorola edge 70 neo with 6.8″ 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED display, 7000mAh battery launched in India


Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 5:29
Instaread

motorola has launched the motorola edge 70 neo in India, as it had announced, introducing a mid-range  smartphone focused on AI-assisted imaging, a high-brightness curved display, a 7,000mAh battery, and MIL-STD-810H durability.

Camera System and AI Photo Tools

The motorola edge 70 neo is equipped with a 50MP Sony LYTIA 710 main camera featuring Optical Image Stabilization (OIS), automatic motion detection, faster shutter response, Video HDR, 4K video recording, and up to 10x Super Zoom. It also includes Pantone Validated colour and skin tone support.

Supporting hardware and software features include:

  • Secondary Sensors: A dedicated macro camera and a 3-in-1 light sensor.
  • Front Camera: A 32MP selfie camera supporting 4K video recording with Adaptive Stabilization across both front and main cameras.
  • Camera Modes & UI: Camera UI 5.0 alongside features such as the Photo Enhancement Engine, Portrait Mode with Dynamic Bokeh, Multiple Focal Lengths, Signature Style, Auto Night Vision, Auto Smile Capture, Dual Capture, Face Retouch, Gesture Capture, Photo Booth, Pro Mode, Panorama, and Live Filters.
  • Google Photos Integration: Includes tools such as Ask Photos, Photo to Video, Recap, Image Editor, Remix, Auto Frame, Magic Eraser, Photo Unblur, Portrait Blur, Portrait Light, Reimagine, Cinematic Photos, Highlight Video, and Video Presets.
Display, Design, and Audio

The smartphone features a 17.22cm (6.8-inch) Extreme AMOLED Super HD (1.5K) quad-curved display with a 1272p resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate. Specifications include:

ComparePhones

  • Visual & Touch Specs: Up to 5,200 nits peak brightness, HDR10+, 100% DCI-P3 colour gamut, 10-bit colour depth, Pantone Validated colour and skin tones, and Water Touch support for wet-hand operation.
  • Audio: Dual stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos support.
  • Build & Finishes: A quad-curved body available in silk-inspired, acetate, and leather-inspired finishes, offered in Pantone-curated colours: Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue, and Sage.
Performance, Battery, and Durability
Discover more

Cell Phones
smartphones

Under the hood, the motorola edge 70 neo runs on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3  Mobile Platform paired with a 4,466mm² vapor chamber cooling system, UFS 3.1 storage, and AI RAM Boost for virtual RAM expansion. On-device and integrated AI features include Circle to Search and Google Gemini.

UpgradePhones

Key endurance and resilience specifications include:

  • Battery & Charging: A 7,000mAh battery rated for up to 53 hours of usage, up to 37 hours of video playback, up to 156 hours of music playback, or up to 24 hours of social media use. It supports TurboPower charging, 7.5W wired reverse charging, and bypass charging during supported Gametime sessions.
  • Durability: SGS-certified MIL-STD-810H compliance (tested from -20°C to 60°C and up to 95% humidity), Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection, and an SGS-tested IP64 rating for dust and splash resistance.
Software and Connectivity

The device ships with Hello UX based on Android 16, backed by a commitment of three Android OS upgrades and Security Maintenance Releases (SMR) running into 2031. Software features include UI customisation, gestures, Auto Blur for screenshots, dedicated spaces for children, centralised security controls, external display/PC/TV projection, and NFC support.

motorola edge 70 neo specifications
  • 6.4-inch (2772 x 1272 pixels) 1.5K Extreme AMOLED display, 144Hz refresh rate, up to 5200 nits peak brightness Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection
  • Up to 2.5GHz Octa Core Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 4nm Mobile Platform with Adreno 720 GPU
  • 8GB LPDDR5X RAM, 128GB UFS 3.1 storage
  • Android 16, 3 OS & 5 years Security updates
  • Dual SIM (nano + nano)
  • 50MP main camera with Sony Sensor – LYTIA  710 sensor, f/1.8 aperture
    OIS, 2MP macro camera, 4K video recording
  • 32MP front camera with f/2.2 aperture, 4k video recording
  • USB Type-C Audio, Stereo speakers, Dolby Atmos
  • Dimensions: 162.7 X 75.7 x 8.49mm; Weight: 204g
  • In-display fingerprint sensor
  • Dust and splash resistant (IP64 ratings), MIL-STD 810H certification
  • 5G SA/NSA, Dual 4G VoLTE, Wi-Fi 6 802.11ax (2.4GHz/5GHz) MIMO, Bluetooth 6.0, GPS, USB Type-C, NFC
  • 7000mAh battery with 45W Turbo charging
Pricing, Offers, and Availability

The motorola edge 70 neo is offered in an 8GB RAM + 128GB storage variant across Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue, and Sage colourways and is priced at ₹40,999.

The device goes on sale starting December 1, 2026, at 12:00 PM via Flipkart, Motorola.in, and offline retail partners including Reliance Digital.

Commenting on the launch, T.M. Narasimhan, Managing Director, Motorola India, said:

At Motorola, we believe meaningful innovation is about creating technology that makes everyday experiences more intuitive, personal and accessible. With the motorola edge 70 neo, we are bringing together AI-powered photography, thoughtful design, immersive entertainment and dependable performance in a device built around the needs of modern consumers. From its Sony LYTIA™ 710 camera and comfortable quad-curved design to its long-lasting battery and everyday durability, the motorola edge 70 neo reflects our continued commitment to delivering purposeful innovation to consumers.
